business_problem: Centrica is a leading UK integrated energy company. It needed to improve the data platform used by its finance teams to make reporting more responsive and efficient.
solution_summary: Centrica used Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI to deliver faster, more responsive analytics from operational data. Centrica is a leading UK integrated energy company. It needed to improve the data platform used by its finance teams to make reporting more responsive and efficient. Key implementation elements included Microsoft Fabric unifies data engineering, storage, and analytics on a single managed platform; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Operational data is ingested from line-of-business systems into the shared data platform, transformed into analytics-ready models, and served to analysts and business users through dashboards and reporting experiences.
